hooks.command: [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" ] || exit 0; pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55432 -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; PGBIN=/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin; D=/var/tmp/v1-verify-pg; [ -d "$D/base" ] || { mkdir -p "$D" && chown postgres:postgres "$D" && sudo -u postgres "$PGBIN/initdb" -D "$D" -A trust >/dev/null 2>&1; }; sudo -u postgres "$PGBIN/pg_ctl" -D "$D" -o "-p 55432 -k /tmp" -l "$D.log" start >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
